items.text: Cincinnati (final): OUT - RG Dalton Risner (knee; Jalen Rivers starts), LB Oren Burks (groin). DOUBTFUL - WR Andrei Iosivas (thumb) and CB Jalen Davis (hamstring). QUESTIONABLE - CB Dax Hill (illness, DNP Sat, expected to play), LG Dylan Fairchild (oblique), S Kyle Dugger (quad), LB Swayze Bozeman, G Brian Parker II (all full Sat). Joe Burrow cleared from illness, off the report, starts.

Washington (final): QUESTIONABLE - RB Rachaad White (heel, DNP Sat), RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin, full Sat, expected to return; Quinn 'optimistic on both' RBs), CB Amik Robertson (ankle, limited), C Lucas Patrick (concussion, full all week). IR - WR Terry McLaurin, OT Laremy Tunsil, DT Daron Payne, LB Leo Chenal. Jayden Daniels (elbow) full practice, starts. Inactives not yet posted at time of note.
